reference_review.floor_policy: Physical floor fixed at native Y=0; video implies small paw/body floor drift.
limitations: Roll direction and lateral detail are authored from a single view; generated belly/body shape changes cannot define native geometry.

support_windows.basis: Reviewed forepaws support the head/chest drop and fold until the body starts rolling; fitted to fixed native sole anchors.

early_collapse_guides.basis: Reviewed early head/chest drop and foreleg folding at reference frames 30,40,50,60. Heights and joint bend are authored native pose guides, not video-measured hidden joints.

physical_hip_height_adapter.policy: Evaluated mean anatomical hip height; preserves each target paw-pivot-to-floor offset.

skin_revision_clearance.unsupported_body_policy: Coupled native chest/hips/head/tail floor contacts; preserve prior body intent with bounded local corrections.

distal_tail_contact_revision.reason: The complete visible tail is long; its terminal surface must settle rather than certifying a proximal bridge.

settling_contact_revision.policy: Guide every actual body support into contact during the last .35 seconds before its stable window, then freeze the actual preceding dense constrained pose. Preserve the earlier authored roll and support timing.

temporal_seed.method: minimum squared third difference; neutral and final held pose fixed

binding.limb_policy: Physical upper/elbow/wrist/paw and hip/stifle/hock/paw directions in rest-cancelled torso frames. Hind source labels corrected without changing source payload.

anatomical_trajectory_fit.endpoint_policy: Original neutral held through .75s; new source-directed final native pose held from established settled event.

jointly_fitted_terminal_pose.blend: Quintic convex native-pose blend with zero first/second derivative at its boundaries; source event times unchanged.

coupled_anatomical_contact_projection.policy: Small coupled native correction, physical segment branch retained; held from the same settled event.
